classification_rationale: This is a damage waiver claim for equipment that broke from being run past its rated limit, and whether the waiver covers that is a policy question the existing terms already answer, not a discretionary discount or a safety incident involving injury or risk to people.

draft.reply_body:
Hello,

Thanks for letting us know, and sorry to hear about the mixer.

I've had a look at this, and because the motor seized from being run continuously past its rated working limit, that falls under one of the standard exclusions on the Damage Waiver Cover — the waiver doesn't cover damage caused by operating equipment outside its stated working limits. So I'm not able to apply the Damage Waiver Cover to this repair, I'm afraid.

The €180 repair cost will go through our normal damage assessment process against our repair-cost schedule, and we'll confirm the final figure with you within five working days; that amount would then come off the deposit held on the booking.

Sorry this isn't the answer you were hoping for — let me know if you'd like to talk it through.

Best regards,
Haapaharju Oy Customer Service

commitments.description: Damage Waiver Cover does not apply because the failure was caused by running the mixer beyond its rated working limit
The repair charge will be assessed through the standard damage assessment process and confirmed within five working days
